moat.overall_moat_verdict_en: This assessment is based on limited public information, particularly the absence of detailed financial statements, and thus the scores represent AI qualitative judgments rather than quantified financial measurements. The company demonstrates some moat characteristics in network effects and customer switching costs, but brand pricing power, patent protection, scale-based cost advantages, and resistance to technological disruption appear relatively weaker. Management's capital allocation and governance structures show proactive efforts, but intense market competition and volatile profitability pose challenges to the moat's durability.

stock.description: Shandong Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd. develops cloud-based PaaS platforms for deploying AI vision solutions in China. It offers AI computer vision solution, a technological solution that simulates the human visual system to enable computers to extract information from images or videos and analyze, make decisions and interact based on this information; and Large model solution that refers to applications built on the functionality of large models, as well as the related supporting services. It caters to retail, communications, real estate, catering, transportation, and public security industries. Shandong Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shenzhen Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shandong Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd. in November 2021. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Qingdao, China with additional offices in Zhuhai and Shenzhen, China; and Hong Kong.

stock.description_zh: 山東極目科技股份有限公司開發基於雲端的PaaS平台，用於在中國部署人工智能視覺解決方案。該公司提供人工智能電腦視覺解決方案，這是一種模擬人類視覺系統的技術解決方案，使電腦能夠從圖像或影片中提取資訊，並基於這些資訊進行分析、決策和互動；以及大型模型解決方案，指基於大型模型功能構建的應用程式，以及相關的支援服務。該公司服務於零售、通訊、房地產、餐飲、交通和公共安全等行業。山東極目科技股份有限公司前身為深圳極目科技股份有限公司，並於二零二一年十一月更名為山東極目科技股份有限公司。該公司於二零一五年成立，總部位於中國青島，並在中國珠海、深圳以及香港設有辦事處。
